tips: Focus heavily on themes like 'reflection on a Quran verse' (Ayat-ul-Kursi, conversion stories), 'trusting Allah (tawakkul)', and 'honesty and trust (amanah)' which consistently bring 1.5x-2x average views.
Avoid dry, preachy topics like 'value of salah' or general behavioral lectures like 'controlling anger', as these performed worst (0.26x to 0.47x).
Avoid complex historical battle stories (e.g., Battle of Qadisiyyah) and generic Sahaba stories that lack a dramatic emotional hook.
Use story hooks featuring direct dramatic encounters or miracles (e.g., Shepherd testing Hazrat Umar, Crying Date Palm Tree, Satan and Hazrat Abu Hurairah) rather than abstract moral advice.
Keep title formats structured around dramatic moments ('جب 313 نے...', 'جب چرواہے نے...') to drive curiosity and click-throughs across both Reels and Long videos.
